a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan has only about a 4% chance of reaching round 3, so it would almost certainly leave us both dead. I plan to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is sure to survive. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. Afterward I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more. If you'd rather settle who takes some other way, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I told you in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I won't pretend it doesn't. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
